previous_statement: For any delta-projections A,B,C in the fixed datum and compatible a in S_{A,B}, b in S_{B,C}, dagger maps S_{A,B} to S_{B,A}, tilde Q is Hermitian, and the compressed product obeys the exact reversal identity (a dot b)^dagger=b^dagger dot a^dagger.
new_statement: For any delta-projections A,B in the fixed datum and every a in S_{A,B}, dagger maps S_{A,B} to S_{B,A}, and tilde Q is Hermitian.
